title: Alabama contractor roster verification
description: Upload a roster CSV you obtained from the Alabama board or another source you are authorized to use. The prefilled query is a synthetic fixture, not live board data. The Actor reads only this uploaded file and never performs live board lookups.

roster_file.title: User-supplied roster CSV
roster_file.description: Upload an authorized roster export as CSV through Apify's file upload. The Actor never performs live board lookups. Direct URLs are restricted to Apify file storage; arbitrary URLs are not fetched.

roster_as_of.title: Roster date
roster_as_of.description: Date the supplied roster reflects, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Results older than 365 days are returned as uncertain.

source_url.title: Official source URL
source_url.description: URL of the board-published roster/export or other authorized official source for the uploaded file. This is recorded as metadata and is never fetched by the Actor.

queries.title: Contractors to check
queries.description: JSON array of up to 100 objects, each with exactly one of license_number or name. Name matching is exact after simple punctuation/case normalization.
